inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored lot, one SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY, one START TRANSACTION, one MariaDB LOCK IN SHARE MODE read, one rejected update, and one rollback.

fixture_notes: One ready lot isolates the pending READ ONLY transaction mode and shared-lock read before the rejected write.
determinism_notes: The lot, statements, expected error, and final projection are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
